messages:
Maya: quick design review — thinking about stacktrace line wrapping in the trace drilldown. current behaviour shows a single long line that overflows horizontally. proposal: soft-wrap lines to container width, show a subtle fade + ellipsis for collapsed rows, and a per-frame "Copy frame" CTA. thoughts?
Jordan: soft-wrap sounds good for readability. concern: we lose visible monospace alignment for long paths. could we keep monospace but allow wrap at logical separators (/, ::, .)?
Priya: implementation note: wrapping at separators is doable in CSS with word-break and white-space tweaks, but long base64 blobs or URLs still force overflow. we can fallback to horizontal scroll on those frames only.
Sam: a11y: if we wrap visually, screenreaders will read the whole line anyway — we need to ensure the visual truncation doesn't truncate the accessible name. put full text in an offscreen element (aria-hidden=false) so SRs get full content. also keyboard focus: the per-frame actions must be reachable by tab in a predictable order.
Alex: copy wording question — current button says "Copy". prefer more explicit: "Copy frame" or "Copy location"? which is clearer for non-dev users?
Maya: leaning "Copy frame" (short, maps to frame action menu). also want a small affordance to reveal full raw line: "Show raw" that toggles. default collapsed for density.
Jordan: +1 for "Show raw" toggle. suggested microcopy: when collapsed show tooltip "Press enter to reveal raw trace" for keyboard users.
Priya: perf note: expanding raw lines for dozens of frames could bloat DOM. keep raw content lazy-rendered when user toggles. add data-attribute to mark unrendered frames for analytics.
Sam: keyboard/aria specifics: use a button with aria-expanded on the "Show raw" control, label it "Show raw frame, collapsed" / "Show raw frame, expanded". for the Copy button use aria-label="Copy stack frame to clipboard" so screenreaders understand what copies. announce success with an assertive live region ("Copied frame to clipboard").
Jordan: visual idea: add a tiny correlation-id pill left of frame timestamp (mono condensed, muted bg). clicking pill copies id. must not steal focus from the frame.
Maya: pill is good for power users. make it opt-in via a per-team toggle in console settings (defaults on for enterprise).
Alex: export action placement: currently export sits in top-right of drilldown header. some PMs want it next to frame actions to allow exporting a single frame. what's the consensus?
Priya: exporting single frame is a rarer flow. adding a tiny per-frame "Export frame" will complicate analytics and perms. prefer export scope selector in header ("Export: all / selection / visible") instead.
Sam: accessibility of export selector — ensure it is a segmented control with clear aria-pressed states and keyboard arrow nav.
Maya: next steps: Jordan to mock the wrap + pill + per-frame actions, Sam to add an a11y checklist, Priya to note perf lazy-render approach, Alex to update copy suggestions. I'll consolidate and push a short RFC. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
